运行前的观察目标

手算与自动微分梯度一致；W[0,0] 的梯度约为 −3.066667，有限差分在容差内相同。

python 02_matrix-grad_demo.py环境配置

自动微分、手算梯度与有限差分三方核对

02_matrix-grad_demo.py
import torch torch.manual_seed(0)# STEP 1: 定义小型双精度回归问题X = torch.tensor([[1., 2.], [-1., 1.], [2., 0.]], dtype=torch.float64)Y = torch.tensor([[3.], [0.], [4.]], dtype=torch.float64)W = torch.tensor([[0.3, -0.2]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)b = torch.tensor([0.1], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)pred = X @ W.T + bloss = 0.5 * (pred - Y).square().mean()loss.backward() # STEP 2: 用与 mean 相同的分母推导矩阵梯度with torch.no_grad():    G = (pred - Y) / pred.numel()    dW = G.T @ X    db = G.sum(dim=0)assert torch.allclose(W.grad, dW)assert torch.allclose(b.grad, db)print("dW:", dW.tolist(), "db:", db.tolist()) # STEP 3: 只扰动一个权重，独立检查该偏导@torch.no_grad()def value(w):    return 0.5 * (X @ w.T + b - Y).square().mean() eps = 1e-6plus, minus = W.detach().clone(), W.detach().clone()plus[0, 0] += epsminus[0, 0] -= epsfinite_difference = (value(plus) - value(minus)) / (2 * eps)assert torch.allclose(finite_difference, W.grad[0, 0], atol=1e-7)print("finite difference:", finite_difference.item())print("三种结果一致；参数此时尚未执行 optimizer.step()。")
